headline: France vs England: Bronze Medal on the Line
whyCareReason: Two semi-final losers, one last chance to leave North America with a medal.
teaser: France and England meet in the third-place play-off after agonising semi-final exits. Pride, ranking points and a podium finish are all on the line.
story:
The third-place match is never the one either side dreamed of, but it is still a World Cup night. France arrive looking to salvage something from a tournament that ended one step short of another final. England arrive with the same hunger after a semi-final that slipped away late.

Expect rotation mixed with pride. Managers will rest some legs and still demand a performance. For players on the fringe of club moves and national hierarchies, this is a stage that still matters.

Kick-off is set for 18 July. One of these nations will leave with bronze.
stakes: Third place at the 2026 World Cup. No final, but a medal and lasting ranking value.
rivalryAngle: Familiar tournament opponents with overlapping club ties and recent knockout pedigree.
funFacts: The third-place play-off has produced some of the World Cup's freest attacking games.
Both sides reached the last four after winning their groups.
Miami hosts another high-profile European meeting in this tournament.

keyPlayers.name: Kylian Mbappé
keyPlayers.hook: Still the most decisive attacker France can throw at open space.

keyPlayers.name: Harry Kane
keyPlayers.hook: A proven big-game finisher chasing a podium end to the campaign.

headToHead: Recent tournament meetings have been defined by fine margins and set-piece quality.
